\section[il tifoso]{il tifoso — a fan}

\label{lesson:IT-C258-tifoso}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Italian for a thread, then the Italian for a tool.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: il tifoso}
\textbf{il tifoso} — \textquotedblleft{}a fan\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{tifoso} — built from \emph{tifo}, \textquotedblleft{}typhus\textquotedblright{}, with \emph{-oso}: a fan is in a fever. \emph{tifo} goes back to Greek \emph{typhos}, \textquotedblleft{}smoke, stupor\textquotedblright{}. EtymDB 2.1 has no row for it.
\end{cousinweb}
